name: Duke Health Youth Symposium on Healthcare Careers
org: Duke Health Volunteer Services (Duke Regional Hospital and Duke Raleigh Hospital)
what_you_do: This is a two-day hospital event for high school students. It has facility tours. It has hands-on CPR training and career activities. Students earn 14 volunteer hours and a certificate.
who_can_apply: High school students who are 16 or 17 (16 by June 24 in 2026). Students must attend both days at one site. Space is limited to 25 slots at each site.
duration: 2 days (2026: June 23-24 at Duke Regional in Durham; June 24-25 at Duke Raleigh Hospital)
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: application opened 8 pm Friday April 10 and closed 8 pm Monday April 13, 2026; acceptance emails by May 1, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Student completes the online application and a parent or guardian completes the Participation Agreement (both on Qualtrics links on the page). No late or incomplete submissions.
notes: Both Duke pages are titled Junior Volunteer Program but describe this event for 2026. The application window was only 3 days, so watch the page in early April. Questions: DRHVolunteerServices@dm.duke.edu (Durham) or DRAH_VolunteerServices@dm.duke.edu (Raleigh). Duke University Hospital says it no longer offers a junior volunteer program for high school students.
